'''Carrier''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] guard who, by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], served aboard the prison barge [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']] which was transporting prisoners to the [[Cog Hive Seven]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]].
